photo_usable.instructions: The photo is sharp and lit well enough, and shows the product fully enough, to judge its condition.

category_match.instructions: The product in the photo is {category}.

damage_visible.instructions: Physical damage is visible (crack, dent, broken part, burn, swelling).

criteria.housing_crack_or_dent: Crack or dent in the housing or body.
criteria.broken_part: A broken or missing part (hinge, port, button).

damage_cause.instructions: Most likely cause of the visible state.

criteria.undetermined: Cannot be determined from the photo.

description_consistent.instructions: The photo is consistent with the customer's description of the problem.
